candidate_dispositions.reason: MUSE uses hierarchical memory inside a broader whole-agent self-evolution loop; retain behind experiment-level applicability rather than treating it as a direct memory-component comparator.

candidate_dispositions.name: Mem2Evolve
candidate_dispositions.reason: The paper is peer reviewed and memory is central to its co-evolution mechanism, but the official project page states the codebase is still undergoing release review; it is not a reproducible direct-memory baseline at this gate.

candidate_dispositions.name: Zep: A Temporal Knowledge Graph Architecture for Agent Memory
candidate_dispositions.reason: Zep is a temporal agent-memory service evaluated primarily on memory retrieval and long-memory reasoning; retain as architecture/reference evidence rather than force it into a directly matched E1 action-policy role.
